# canonical hierarchy

```{r}
canonical <- c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4")
noncanonical <- c("V2", "V1", "V4", "V3")
hierarchy <- data.table(id = 1:4, canonical, noncanonical)
hierarchy<- melt(hierarchy, id.vars = "id", variable.name = "type", value.name = "value")

plot_hierarchy <-
  ggplot(hierarchy, aes(x = type, y = id, label = value)) +
  geom_label(aes(color = value), size = 5) +
  scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  ggtitle("visual hierarchy") +
  xlab(element_blank()) +
  ylab(element_blank()) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8, family = "Calibri Light"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
plot_hierarchy
```

# bootstrap

```{r}
bootstrap_df <- fread("../data_raw/btsrp_for_fig.csv")

bootstrap_df$Group <- as_factor(bootstrap_df$Group)
bootstrap_df$Order <- as_factor(bootstrap_df$Order)
bootstrap_df$Gradient <- as_factor(bootstrap_df$Gradient)
bootstrap_df[, percent := Frequency/100, by = .(Group, Gradient)]

sc_g1_df <- bootstrap_df[Gradient == "G1" & Group == "SC",]
setorder(sc_g1_df, percent)
sc_g1_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))]
cb_g1_df <- bootstrap_df[Gradient == "G1" & Group == "CB",]
cb_g1_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(sc_g1_df$Order))]
sc_g1_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))] # Ensure that the factor variable is set correctly in sc_g3_df
ordered_levels <- levels(sc_g1_df$Order) # Extract the levels from sc_g3_df
cb_g1_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = ordered_levels)] # Apply the same levels to cb_g3_df
g1_df <- rbind(sc_g1_df, cb_g1_df)
g1_df <- g1_df[percent >= 1,]

g1_plot <- create_lolli_plot2(g1_df, percent, Order, "Gradient 1", c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71")) +
  ylab("Order\n")

sc_g2_df <- bootstrap_df[Gradient == "G2" & Group == "SC",]
setorder(sc_g2_df, percent)
sc_g2_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))]
cb_g2_df <- bootstrap_df[Gradient == "G2" & Group == "CB",]
cb_g2_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(sc_g2_df$Order))]
sc_g2_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))] # Ensure that the factor variable is set correctly in sc_g3_df
ordered_levels <- levels(sc_g2_df$Order) # Extract the levels from sc_g3_df
cb_g2_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = ordered_levels)] # Apply the same levels to cb_g3_df
g2_df <- rbind(sc_g2_df, cb_g2_df)
g2_df <- g2_df[percent >= 1,]

g2_plot <- create_lolli_plot2(g2_df, percent, Order, "Gradient 2", c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"))

sc_g3_df <- bootstrap_df[Gradient == "G3" & Group == "SC",]
setorder(sc_g3_df, percent)
sc_g3_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))]
cb_g3_df <- bootstrap_df[Gradient == "G3" & Group == "CB",]
cb_g3_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(sc_g3_df$Order))]
sc_g3_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))] # Ensure that the factor variable is set correctly in sc_g3_df
ordered_levels <- levels(sc_g3_df$Order) # Extract the levels from sc_g3_df
cb_g3_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = ordered_levels)] # Apply the same levels to cb_g3_df
g3_df <- rbind(sc_g3_df, cb_g3_df)
g3_df <- g3_df[percent >= 1,]

g3_plot <- create_lolli_plot2(g3_df, percent, Order, "Gradient 3", c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"))

set_null_device(cairo_pdf)
boot_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  g1_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  g2_plot + theme(legend.position = "none") + ylab(""),
  g3_plot + theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.1)) + ylab(""),
  ncol = 3
)
boot_row

```

# single subject

```{r}
chisqr <- fread("../data_raw/ChiSquareTest_for_fig.csv")
chisqr <- chisqr[Frequency > 0,]
chisqr$Order <- as_factor(chisqr$Order)

sc_g1_df <- chisqr[Gradient == "G1" & Group == "SC",]
setorder(sc_g1_df, Frequency)
sc_g1_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))]
cb_g1_df <- chisqr[Gradient == "G1" & Group == "CB",]
cb_g1_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(sc_g1_df$Order))]
sc_g1_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))] # Ensure that the factor variable is set correctly in sc_g3_df
ordered_levels <- levels(sc_g1_df$Order) # Extract the levels from sc_g3_df
cb_g1_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = ordered_levels)] # Apply the same levels to cb_g3_df
g1_df <- rbind(sc_g1_df, cb_g1_df)
g1_df <- g1_df[Frequency >= 1,]
g1_df <- g1_df[!is.na(Order),]

g1_plot <- create_lolli_plot2(g1_df, Frequency, Order, "", c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71")) +
  ylab("Order\n")

sc_g2_df <- chisqr[Gradient == "G2" & Group == "SC",]
setorder(sc_g2_df, Frequency)
sc_g2_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))]
cb_g2_df <- chisqr[Gradient == "G2" & Group == "CB",]
cb_g2_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(sc_g2_df$Order))]
sc_g2_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))] # Ensure that the factor variable is set correctly in sc_g3_df
ordered_levels <- levels(sc_g2_df$Order) # Extract the levels from sc_g3_df
cb_g2_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = ordered_levels)] # Apply the same levels to cb_g3_df
g2_df <- rbind(sc_g2_df, cb_g2_df)
g2_df <- g2_df[Frequency >= 1,]
g2_df <- g2_df[!is.na(Order),]

g2_plot <- create_lolli_plot2(g2_df, Frequency, Order, "", c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"))

sc_g3_df <- chisqr[Gradient == "G3" & Group == "SC",]
setorder(sc_g3_df, Frequency)
sc_g3_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))]
cb_g3_df <- chisqr[Gradient == "G3" & Group == "CB",]
cb_g3_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(sc_g3_df$Order))]
sc_g3_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = unique(Order))] # Ensure that the factor variable is set correctly in sc_g3_df
ordered_levels <- levels(sc_g3_df$Order) # Extract the levels from sc_g3_df
cb_g3_df[, Order := factor(Order, levels = ordered_levels)] # Apply the same levels to cb_g3_df
g3_df <- rbind(sc_g3_df, cb_g3_df)
g3_df <- g3_df[Frequency >= 1,]
g3_df <- g3_df[!is.na(Order),]

g3_plot <- create_lolli_plot2(g3_df, Frequency, Order, "", c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"))

chiq_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  g1_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  g2_plot + theme(legend.position = "none") + ylab(""),
  g3_plot + ylab(""),
  ncol = 3
)
chiq_row

```

# Figure 3

```{r}
fig_3 <- ggarrange(
  plot_hierarchy,
  ggarrange(
    boot_row,
    chiq_row,
    ncol = 1,
    align = "v",
    labels = c("B", "C")
  ),
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(1, 3),
  labels = c("A", "")
)

setwd('../figures')

cowplot::set_null_device(cairo_pdf)
ggsave(
  fig_3,
  filename = "figure_3.pdf",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  height = 10,
  width = 16.5,
  units = "cm",
  bg = "transparent",
  dpi = "print"
)
```

```{r}
setwd("../data_tidy/")

dt_long <- readRDS("gradients.RDS")
dt_long <- dt_long[, .(mean_score = mean(gradient_score)),
                   by = .(subject, region, group, gradient, yeo, stream)]
dt_long$group <- factor(dt_long$group, levels = c("SC", "CB"))

visual_dt <- dt_long[!is.na(stream),]
visual_dt[, order := rank(mean_score), by = .(subject, stream, group, gradient)]

visual_sum <- visual_dt[, .(sum_order = length(.I)),
                        by = .(group, stream, order, region, gradient)]

total_orders <- visual_dt[, .(total_order = .N), by = .(group, stream, region, gradient)]
visual_sum <- merge(visual_sum, total_orders, by = c("group", "stream", "region", "gradient"))
visual_sum[, proportion := sum_order / total_order]

all_dist <- readRDS("minimum_distances.RDS")
```

# visual hierarchy

## Figure 4B

```{r}
min_dist_g1_long <- all_dist[gradient == "gradient 1",]
min_dist_g1_long <- min_dist_g1_long[, log_score := log(distance)]
min_dist_g1_long$title <- "Gradient 1"

fig_g1 <- create_violin_boxplot(
  data = min_dist_g1_long,
  x_var = "roi",
  y_var = "log_score",
  color_var = "group",
  theme = mytheme,
  x_label = "",
  y_label = "log(minimum distance)\n",
  fill_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"),

)

min_dist_g2_long <- all_dist[gradient == "gradient 2",]
min_dist_g2_long <- min_dist_g2_long[, log_score := log(distance)]

fig_g2 <- create_violin_boxplot(

min_dist_g3_long <- all_dist[gradient == "gradient 3",]

fig_g3 <- create_violin_boxplot(
```

# analysis - minimum distance of regions to each other

## gradient 1

```{r}
model_g1 <- mixed(log(distance) ~ group*roi + (1|subject),
                  min_dist_g1_long)
model_g1
```

### EMMs

```{r}
emm_int <- emmeans(model_g1, ~ group | roi, type = "response")
emm_int
```

### post-hoc tests

```{r}
update(pairs(emm_int), adjust = "holm", by = NULL)
```

## gradient 2

